outcomes.reason: ["Whether the Code of Fair Competition for the Iron and Steel Industry approved by this order on August 19, 1933 ended before the June 14, 1935 repeal is not established by held evidence. The held text of EO 6730 (May 30, 1934; SUPPLEMENT:EO6730) approves \"certain amendments to the Code of Fair Competition of the Iron and Steel Industry as approved on August 19, 1933\" and then \"said Code as amended\", \"said revised Code incorporating said amendments to become effective on June 11, 1934, prior to which effective date the Code of Fair Competition approved August 19, 1933, shall continue in full force and effect\". It does not say that the August 19, 1933 approval ceased on June 11, 1934, nor that it continued after that date as the amended code, and it neither revokes nor cancels the 1933 approval. The reviewed shared analysis leaves open whether a revised-code approval supersedes or merely amends an earlier approval. If EO 6730 superseded the 1933 code, the first end is June 11, 1934 (the 1933 code was in force only before that date); if it only amended it, the first end is the June 14, 1935 repeal. No held source (the code text, its Article XII, or an NRA release) decides between them, so neither date is claimed."]

["The only held text of EO 6438 (November 17, 1933) is the American Presidency Project page captured from the Wayback Machine (2023-09-04T04:27:09Z; the clause-drafts copy is the same capture, same sha256). A Wayback-only capture cannot be re-proven offline, no other registered text of EO 6438 is held, and the register best-held grade is transcription_only, so the approval cannot be supported on re-provable custody until a ProQuest, government printed or Common Crawl copy is held. Separately, the order is not a plain approval: it approves the Hotel code \"excepting, however, subsection (d) of section 1 of article IV\" subject to conditions (1) elimination of that subsection, (2) a hearing \"within 90 days from the effective date of this code\", and (3) that the further order \"shall constitute a modification of\" the approval. The held excerpt SUPPLEMENT:EO6620B (EO 6620-B, February 26, 1934) modifies the approval \"by striking therefrom the conditions numbered two (2) and three (3)\", which would end conditions 2 and 3 on February 26, 1934 (no held effective date for the code is needed for that end); the approval and condition 1 would then end by the June 14, 1935 repeal absent an earlier record, and no held record shows a hearing, report or further order. These clause ends are recorded here but not claimed, because the source custody gap blocks the whole order."]
